//: Dev auto-reload (npm run dev). Watch ONLY the backend source plus the two files the server reads at boot: the vanilla-JS frontend under public/ is served statically and is picked up by a browser reload, so it never needs a server restart. Watching the whole tree (public/assets, private-uploads, data/) is heavy on Windows file-watchers and risks spurious restarts on any runtime file write. Ported from icelandicstore.
